entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I think I need to return something? I'm a bit lost with the website. It's all so confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. Can you please provide me with your order number? And to be sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the item or more of a preference issue?
My order number is... VF78901. It's the cycling shoes I bought. I tried them once, but they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. I'm just not sure they're right for me.
I'm sorry to hear about the blisters, that sounds very uncomfortable. Let me just pull up your order... VF78901. I see you received the cycling shoes 11 days ago. No problem at all.
Oh, is that okay? I thought I read something about 10 days, and then I couldn't figure out the cleats, and I just got overwhelmed. Can't you just help me?
Of course. There's no need to worry. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the timeframe. I can go ahead and process a full refund for you right now.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief! Thank you. I was so stressed about it.

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Just package the shoes back in their original box and drop them off at any post office. Once we receive them, your refund will be processed.
Okay, I can do that. Thank you so much, Isaac.
Happy to help. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
